answer: A new identity needs 5 distinct neighbors, each staking a 40-credit ferrous bond; all 5 are sealed in a public violet registry auditors replay. A comet audit re-checks claims every 20 epochs and catches rented-neighbor rings: a false attestation burns the bond and voids the identity. Forging 1,000 identities costs 200,000 credits against a 40,000-credit pool, so forgery loses money. Honest agents need 5 neighbors once and keep the violet seal.
